sources.snippet: ComfyUI-Auto-Installer-Assets is a pure asset repository containing pre-packaged model files and binaries for the UmeAiRT ecosystem, maintained by UmeAiRT. This is not a model itself but rather a centralized distribution system delivering diffusion models, text encoders, LoRAs, ControlNets, VAEs, and binary dependencies for ComfyUI workflows.
